from qiskit.aer.noise.errors import depolarizing_channel
from qiskit.circuit.library import ZZSwap

    J1, J2, h = params
    qc = QuantumCircuit(*wires)

    for i in range(len(wires) - 1):
        qc.z(wires[i]) @ qc.z(wires[i + 1]) * J1
    for i in range(len(wires) - 2):
        qc.z(wires[i]) @ qc.z(wires[i + 2]) * J2
    for i in range(len(wires)):
        qc.x(wires[i]) * h

    return qc

def observables(params, wires):
    M2 = (1 / len(wires)) * qml.expectation_value(qml.PauliZ(wires[0]) + ... + qml.PauliZ(wires[-1])) ** 2
    chi_z = 10 * (qml.var(qml.PauliZ(wires[0]) + ... + qml.PauliZ(wires[-1])) - M2)
    U4 = 1 - qml.expectation_value(qml.PauliZ(wires[0]) ** 4) / (3 * M2 ** 2)
    C_2 = (1 / 8) * qml.expectation_value(qml.PauliZ(wires[0]) @ qml.PauliZ(wires[1]) + ... + qml.PauliZ(wires[-2]) @ qml.PauliZ(wires[-1]))
    C_1 = (1 / 9) * qml.expectation_value(qml.PauliZ(wires[0]) @ qml.PauliZ(wires[1]) + ... + qml.PauliZ(wires[-2]) @ qml.PauliZ(wires[-1]) + qml.PauliZ(wires[-1]) @ qml.PauliZ(wires[0]))

    backend = QuantumInstance(device, shots=8192)

    results = {}

        qc.initialize(10 * [1])
        qc.barrier(num_spins)
        qc.measure_all()

        M2, chi_z, U4, C_2, C_1 = observables(params, range(num_spins))
        results[h] = {'M2': M2, 'chi_z': chi_z, 'U4': U4, 'C_2': C_2, 'C_1': C_1}

        return 1 - M2 ** 4 / (3 * M2 ** 2)
